principles: Repository-local executable behavior outranks stale prose.
Translation must preserve technical meaning and distinguish current rules from legacy history.
Every correction must have a reproducible source or command check.
drivers: The user asked for both complete English and proof of version consistency.
The existing document contains active-looking instructions for commands that no longer exist.
The current managed-asset recognizer explicitly accepts an English expanded AGENTS guide.

options.name: A: Literal translation only
pros: Easy to diff against the Chinese source
cons: Would preserve proven broken commands and outdated lifecycle instructions
Would fail the requested current-version consistency check

options.name: B: Evidence-backed English translation with narrow current-version corrections
pros: Delivers a fully English prompt that operators can follow
Corrects only claims disproven by current CLI/source evidence
Keeps legacy background when clearly labeled
cons: Requires careful verification that corrections do not overstate current behavior

chosen: B: Evidence-backed English translation with narrow current-version corrections
rationale: Option B is the only approach that satisfies both requested outcomes: a complete English file and an evidence-backed consistency result that does not knowingly preserve broken current instructions.

preMortem.scenario: A Chinese string or mojibake remains in the translated file.
preMortem.trigger: CJK or replacement-character scan returns any match.
preMortem.consequence: The file is not fully translated.
preMortem.mitigation: Run explicit Unicode Han and U+FFFD scans after editing and inspect every residual match.

preMortem.scenario: A historical command is translated as if it were still runnable.
preMortem.trigger: Extracted command list contains a name rejected by current local CLI help.
preMortem.mitigation: Remove active invocations and describe retired commands only as historical, non-runnable background.

preMortem.scenario: A current lifecycle gate is lost or misstated during translation.
preMortem.trigger: Diff review disagrees with story-lifecycle.md or current command help.
preMortem.consequence: Agents can follow an invalid phase path.
preMortem.mitigation: Cross-check lifecycle, INIT, REVIEW, TEST, and DONE sections against authoritative sources and run documentation review.
